anomalies.description: A person outside the store deliberately smashes the glass of the sliding door with an object (likely a rock or similar projectile), causing visible shattering and spiderweb cracking of the pane. This constitutes vandalism—damaging property where it stands—matching the expected anomaly type.

original_descriptions.description: A person outside the store deliberately smashes the glass of the sliding door with an object (likely a rock or similar projectile), causing visible shattering and spiderweb cracking of the pane.
